Car aircond service in Bukit Indah

Johor heat is hard on a car aircond. If the cabin will not cool, the air smells or the blower is noisy, bring it in.

Aircond flushing

The Car Air Cond Flushing Service banner hangs above our workshop bays. Ask us on WhatsApp whether flushing suits your car.

What to tell us

Say whether the air is warm all the time or only at idle, and whether you hear or smell anything when it runs.

WhatsApp 011-6776 1138Call

Questions drivers ask

Why is my aircond only cold when driving?

There are a few possible reasons. We check the system in the bay and tell you what we find.

How long does aircond work take?

It depends on what the check finds. WhatsApp us your model and the symptoms first.
